description: Sets know-how protection on a PLC block with a password (protect:true, the default) or removes it (protect:false, with the same password). GATE G6: the password comes from a HUMAN — never invented, guessed or reused; a password nobody knows locks the block for good. Never retry a rejected password with a guess: after one rejected unprotect, TIA has refused even the correct password for the rest of the session. The dryRun plan shows the password as [redacted]. The password travels to the serve over plain HTTP — keep the serve on this host or a trusted network. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/blocks/{block}/protect {password, protect}. Class M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

password.description: G6: the know-how password provided by a HUMAN, never invented

protect.description: true = protect (default), false = remove the protection
